newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita, Meditrust to merge.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita, Meditrust to merge.

text.p: The Santa Anita Cos on Sunday said it will merge with Meditrust, in a tax-free transaction between the two real estate investment trust, or REIT, firms, valued at about $383 million.

Under the terms of the agreement, shareholders of Meditrust will receive 1.2016 paired-shares of Santa Anita for each Meditrust share. Paired-shares twin the shares of an operating company and a REIT together on a one-for-one basis with the shares trading as a unit, Santa Anita said.
Meditrust has agreed to buy 1.2 million paired-shares of Santa Anita at $31 each.

Santa Anita holders will have an option to sell their shares at $31 a share for up to 3.2 million shares. Or they may keep them and receive the dividend rate given to Meditrust holders, which is $0.7125 per share.
Santa Anita's last quarterly dividend was $0.20 per share.
Santa Anita said it has also agreed to sell one million Santa Anita common paired-shares to one or more independent parties designated by Meditrust.

The merger will create a combined, paired-share company, named Meditrust Corp, with a market capitalization of $2.6 billion. It will be based in Needham, Mass., and will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol MT.
